objects.name: capital_snapshots
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE capital_snapshots(observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,period_end TEXT,total_shares INTEGER,limited_shares INTEGER,unlimited_shares INTEGER,unit TEXT,daily_effective_date TEXT,model_input_approved INTEGER CHECK(model_input_approved=0),payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 8个期末股本观察；不是逐日流通分母。

objects.name: chip_evidence_files
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE chip_evidence_files(observation_id TEXT,role TEXT,project_relative_path TEXT,sha256 TEXT,exists_locally INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(observation_id,role),FOREIGN KEY(observation_id) REFERENCES chip_observations(observation_id))
objects.description: 每次筹码观察的真实证据文件及哈希；exists_locally=0显式留缺口。

objects.name: chip_observations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE chip_observations(observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,collection TEXT,expected_date TEXT,actual_date TEXT,kline_date TEXT,accepted_capture INTEGER,profit_ratio_pct REAL,average_cost_display REAL,cost90_low REAL,cost90_high REAL,concentration90_pct REAL,cost70_low REAL,cost70_high REAL,concentration70_pct REAL,kline_basis_control TEXT,context TEXT,observed_at_utc TEXT,complete_price_bins INTEGER CHECK(complete_price_bins=0),model_input_approved INTEGER CHECK(model_input_approved=0),evidence_directory TEXT,payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 筹码摘要采集尝试；accepted_capture仅指日期对齐等采集检查通过。

objects.name: conflicts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE conflicts(conflict_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,collection TEXT,symbol TEXT,reference_date TEXT,field_name TEXT,status TEXT,payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 逐字段或逐日版本差异；条数不等于独立问题日期数。

objects.name: corporate_actions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE corporate_actions(event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,symbol TEXT,attributable_period TEXT,record_date TEXT,ex_date TEXT,official_cash_date TEXT,cash_cny_per_10_gross TEXT,transfer_shares_per_10 TEXT,total_shares_before INTEGER,total_shares_after INTEGER,first_publication_time TEXT,model_input_approved INTEGER CHECK(model_input_approved=0),payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 3次分派经济事件；记录日、除权日与代派支付日分开。

objects.name: daily_coverage
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE daily_coverage(trade_date TEXT PRIMARY KEY,is_warmup INTEGER,stock_raw_bar INTEGER,stock_qfq_bar INTEGER,market_background INTEGER,chip_full_capture INTEGER,chip_accepted_observations INTEGER,chip_distinct_value_sets INTEGER,condition_table_present INTEGER,official_daily_state_known INTEGER,official_limit_prices_known INTEGER,calendar_evidence_present INTEGER,margin_observation INTEGER,fund_flow_observation INTEGER,event_date_roles INTEGER)
objects.description: 1160日覆盖矩阵；0表示无对应记录/证据，不表示真实数值为0。

objects.name: document_pages
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE document_pages(art_code TEXT,page_number INTEGER,source_sha256 TEXT,extractor TEXT,text TEXT,status TEXT,error TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(art_code,page_number,source_sha256))
objects.description: 4253页文本提取结果；不把可提取文字称为全部内容核实。

objects.name: events
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE events(event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,event_type TEXT,event_date TEXT,date_role TEXT,economic_episode_id TEXT,source_url TEXT,source_sha256 TEXT,raw_path TEXT,source_timestamp_raw_json TEXT,first_publication_time TEXT,earliest_model_use_time TEXT,source_level TEXT,model_input_approved INTEGER CHECK(model_input_approved=0),payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 67个日期角色，59个经济事件标识；规则候选不等于逐月官方证实。

objects.name: fee_components
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE fee_components(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,fee TEXT,effective_date TEXT,research_from TEXT,research_to TEXT,buy_rate REAL,sell_rate REAL,status TEXT,payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 7条费用构成/历史段；不是用户真实账户完整费率。

objects.name: file_assets
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE file_assets(project_relative_path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,sha256 TEXT,bytes INTEGER,exists_locally INTEGER,prior_audit_sha256 TEXT,references_json TEXT)
objects.description: 本地来源审计选定的5390个原件/证据文件；不是全项目文件清单。

objects.name: filings
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE filings(art_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT,notice_date TEXT,original_path TEXT,original_sha256 TEXT,original_url TEXT,original_retrieved_at TEXT,current_catalogue_retrieved_at TEXT,first_publication_time TEXT,availability_status TEXT,model_input_approved INTEGER CHECK(model_input_approved=0),time_payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 312份公告原件；目录刷新时间与首次公开时刻分开。

objects.name: financial_report_observations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE financial_report_observations(art_code TEXT,source_sha256 TEXT,report_period TEXT,metric TEXT,value_decimal TEXT,unit TEXT,provider_notice_date TEXT,availability_status TEXT,evidence_json TEXT)
objects.description: 135项财报原件观察；金额单位、期间和修订逐项保留。

objects.name: gaps
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE gaps(gap_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,priority INTEGER,status TEXT,explanation TEXT,next_evidence_needed TEXT)
objects.description: 未取得、未核实、版本不一致等9类主要缺口。

objects.name: ingestion_sources
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE ingestion_sources(dataset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT,source_path TEXT,source_sha256 TEXT,source_rows INTEGER,source_min_date TEXT,source_max_date TEXT,role TEXT)
objects.description: 本次导入清单；行数是来源记录数，不是独立样本数。

objects.name: instrument_identifiers
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE instrument_identifiers(provider_symbol TEXT PRIMARY KEY,canonical_symbol TEXT,instrument_name TEXT,instrument_type TEXT,price_unit TEXT,mapping_evidence TEXT)
objects.description: 原供应商标识到统一证券标识及价格单位的映射。

objects.name: market_daily

objects.name: metadata
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value_json TEXT NOT NULL)
objects.description: 版本、选择策略和受限字段定义。

objects.name: ocr_pages
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE ocr_pages(run_id TEXT,art_code TEXT,page_number INTEGER,source_sha256 TEXT,text TEXT,status TEXT,payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 185页本地OCR结果；尚未完成人工核验。

objects.name: source_records
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE source_records(dataset_id TEXT,seq INTEGER,record_kind TEXT,reference_date TEXT,source_record_id TEXT,payload_json TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(dataset_id,seq))
objects.description: 保留旧库及补缺资料的清理后结构化载荷；受限字段已另库隔离。

objects.name: source_requests
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE source_requests(request_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,request_id TEXT,url TEXT,raw_path TEXT,source_sha256 TEXT,retrieved_at TEXT,requested_at TEXT,normalized_requested_start TEXT,normalized_requested_end TEXT,time_semantics TEXT,payload_json TEXT)

objects.sql: CREATE TABLE trade_conditions(trade_date TEXT PRIMARY KEY,symbol TEXT,rule_id TEXT,historical_st_state TEXT,intraday_suspension_state TEXT,official_normal_state INTEGER,official_upper_limit REAL,official_lower_limit REAL,broker_commission_rate REAL,cost_model_complete INTEGER,execution_eligible INTEGER,original_bar_available INTEGER,current_bar_available INTEGER,previous_close_unadjusted_candidate REAL,previous_close_date TEXT,ex_rights_date INTEGER,limit_reference_price REAL,derived_context_status TEXT,payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 915日交易条件原记录及最新行情的派生关联；未知状态留NULL。

objects.name: trade_rules
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE trade_rules(rule_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,effective_date TEXT,research_from TEXT,research_to TEXT,normal_limit_pct REAL,st_limit_pct REAL,buy_lot INTEGER,price_tick_cny REAL,validation_scope TEXT,payload_json TEXT)

objects.name: trading_calendar
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE trading_calendar(trade_date TEXT,exchange_scope TEXT,is_scheduled_open INTEGER,calendar_version TEXT,payload_json TEXT)
objects.description: 旧日历原件证据；最新观测行情日未据此补成官方日历。

objects.name: approved_chip_inputs
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW approved_chip_inputs AS SELECT * FROM chip_observations WHERE model_input_approved=1
objects.description: 当前空集；摘要初始化、版本和历史当时可得尚未认证。

objects.name: approved_market_inputs
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW approved_market_inputs AS SELECT * FROM market_daily WHERE model_input_approved=1
objects.description: 当前空集；不把资料入库等同研究准入。

objects.name: market_reference
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW market_reference AS SELECT m.*,
          EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conflicts c WHERE c.collection=m.collection AND c.symbol=m.symbol AND c.reference_date=m.trade_date AND c.field_name IN ('open','high','low','close')) AS has_price_source_conflict,
          EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conflicts c WHERE c.collection=m.collection AND c.symbol=m.symbol AND c.reference_date=m.trade_date AND c.field_name IN ('volume_raw','volume_provider_native')) AS has_volume_source_conflict
          FROM market_daily m WHERE collection='market_industry_oct21' AND provider='eastmoney'
objects.description: 固定选择最新采集集中的东方财富，供浏览；仍显示来源冲突。

objects.name: stock_qfq_reference
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW stock_qfq_reference AS SELECT * FROM market_reference WHERE symbol='002414.SZ' AND adjustment='1'
objects.description: 上述浏览入口中的高德红外本次前复权快照1160日。

objects.name: stock_raw_reference
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW stock_raw_reference AS SELECT * FROM market_reference WHERE symbol='002414.SZ' AND adjustment='0'
objects.description: 上述浏览入口中的高德红外不复权1160日。
